# espanso-snippets

<!-- readme-audit: private -->

My espanso text-expansion snippets, synced between my laptops.

## Setup

```bash
git clone git@example.com:me/espanso-snippets.git ~/.config/espanso/match/personal
cd ~/.config/espanso/match/personal
```

## Usage

Pull the latest snippets and check them for clashes:

```bash
./pull.sh
python3 test_check.py
```
